salesfact::CALCULATE([TOTAL UNITS],SAMEP.sql:
WITH "ShiftedDates" AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT DATEADD(year, -1, salesfact."date"::DATE) AS "shifted_date"
    FROM salesfact
    WHERE salesfact."date" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    SUM(salesfact."units")
FROM
    salesfact
WHERE
    salesfact."date"::DATE IN (SELECT "shifted_date" FROM "ShiftedDates");

salesfact::CALCULATE([Total Units YTD],.sql:
```sql
SELECT
    salesfact."Date",
    (
        SELECT
            SUM(salesfact_inner."Units")
        FROM
            salesfact AS salesfact_inner

            salesfact_inner."Date" >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATEADD('YEAR', -1, salesfact."Date"))
            AND salesfact_inner."Date" <= DATEADD('YEAR', -1, salesfact."Date")
    ) AS "Total Units YTD SPLY"
FROM
    salesfact;
```
